key_finding.interpretation: All 3 runs diverge at exactly step 136 with identical issue patterns. A 0.3mm EEF Y-offset is already present at step 135 pre-action. Contact dynamics (29→30 contacts) amplify this sub-pixel offset into macroscopic trajectory divergence. This is a fundamental limitation of floating-point determinism in contact-rich MuJoCo simulation, not a replay protocol error.

implications_for_teacher: Exact replay is NOT available for contact-sensitive trajectories near static fixtures. The C3 hybrid data contract must use: (a) static fixture world poses from invariance seal (not replay), (b) dynamic object poses from original sidecar, (c) basket via body→site reconstruction. Replay-dependent geometry validation is structurally impossible for fixture-contact episodes.
verdict: VALID — systematic divergence confirmed, mechanism understood, implications for Teacher data contract documented.
